mapper.select: SELECT JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.metricCode')) metric_code, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.displayName')) display_name, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.ownerModule')) owner_module, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.entityType')) entity_type, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.distinctKey')) distinct_key, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.timeField')) time_field, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.defaultWindow')) default_window, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.definition')) definition, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.drilldownPath')) drilldown_path, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.metricVersion')) metric_version,updated_at FROM t_system_config WHERE config_type='METRIC_DEFINITION' AND is_active=1 ORDER BY owner_team,config_key LIMIT #{limit}
